facts.excerpt: rooftop sign was installed in 1932 and has since become a fixture of the city skyline

facts.text: Central Park and the Central Park Zoo are just across the street from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is an easy walk from Lincoln Center, Carnegie Hall, Columbus Circle and Fifth Avenue.

facts.text: Rooms include plush bedding, marble bathrooms, minibars, work desks and Wi-Fi.

facts.text: Each suite in the Central Park Suite Collection tells a distinct story through design and artwork inspired by personalities who shaped New York's cultural landscape.
facts.excerpt: Each fully reimagined suite tells a distinct story through design, artwork, and other touches inspired by personalities who helped shape the cultural landscape of New York City.

facts.text: The Promenade Suite is a two-bedroom suite on the 38th floor with panoramic Central Park views.

facts.text: The Delacorte Presidential Suite honors George T. Delacorte, founder of Dell Publishing.

facts.text: The Meadow Terrace Suite has terrace views overlooking Central Park's Sheep Meadow.

facts.text: The Artisans Terrace Suite's design nods to Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue, with a piano key installation and a hand-painted mural.
facts.excerpt: Design nods to Gershwin’s “Rhapsody in Blue,” with a piano key installation and vibrant hand-painted mural.

facts.text: The Central Park running tour is complimentary for hotel guests on Saturdays.
